en.description: Browse live agency property listings on an interactive map and send inquiries with your phone number and listing name directly to the agent.

landing.headline: Find real properties — skip the outdated ads
landing.subheadline: Property seekers browse live listings pinned on a map; every inquiry reaches the agent with a phone number and listing name already attached.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything buyers and agents need in one place

features.title: Live map of listings
features.description: Every current property is pinned on the map so visitors can explore by location, not just scroll through a list.

features.title: Inquiries with full context
features.description: Each contact form captures the visitor's phone number and the listing name, so the agent knows exactly who to call and about which property.

features.title: No duplicates, no stale ads
features.description: Listings are managed directly by the agency, keeping the catalogue current and free of repeated or outdated entries.

features.title: Lead tracker for agents
features.description: Log and follow every incoming inquiry through a board, from first contact all the way to a closed deal.

howItWorks.heading: From browsing to a booked viewing in four steps

steps.title: Browse the map
steps.description: Open the interactive map to see all current agency properties pinned at their real locations.

steps.title: Pick a property
steps.description: Select any listing to read the full description, price, area and key highlights.

steps.title: Send your inquiry
steps.description: Leave your name and phone number; the form attaches the property name automatically.

steps.title: Expect a call back
steps.description: The agent receives one email with your contact details and the property name and calls you directly.

dashboard.title: Inquiry Overview
dashboard.intro: Track all incoming property inquiries, see their status at a glance, and follow up with every interested client.
